title.en: The One With the Bridal Bouquet

description.es: Fina va a la casa grande para ver a Marta antes de la boda. Le da a Marta un ramo de novia hecho con las flores de su jardín, y hablan. Mientras el cura oficia la ceremonia, Marta piensa en los momentos vividos con Fina. El cura dice que nunca en su vida ha visto a una novia mirar con un amor tan intenso, y que van a ser muy felices. La noche de bodas, Marta se va de la casa grande, se encuentra con Fina, y hacen el amor en el coche.
description.en: Fina goes to the big house to see Marta before the wedding. She gives Marta a bridal bouquet made from the flowers in their garden, and they talk. As the priest performs the ceremony, Marta thinks about her memories with Fina. The priest says that he has never in his life seen a bride look with such intense love, and that they are going to be very happy. On the wedding night, Marta leaves the big house, meets Fina, and they make love in the car.
